entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Proposal] Code analyzer that detects unnecessary allocations made for dictionary lookups #51221
  • CA1842 ("Do not use WhenAll with a single task") does not trigger diagnostic #51219
  • The "dotnet" command is not recognized after installing 18.0 Insiders + 10.0 RTM SDK #51218

Closed

  • dotnet tool packages don't seem to have project repo links when viewed in nuget.org #51224
  • `main` is now .NET 11, use `release/10.0.1xx` for .NET 10 work! #50394
    11.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • Output #51227
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Clean up browser communication protocol #51226
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51225
  • Refactor dotnet-watch into a package consumable from Aspire.CLI #51223
  • Delete the 'main is .net 11' warning now that it's served its purpose #51222
  • [dotnet-watch] Remove excess logging that slows down Hot Reload #51220

Merged

  • Suppress all nullable warnings for files in source packages when targeting net472 and netstandard #51193
  • [release/10.0.1xx][HotReload] Allow hot reload refresh script injection for 404 status code #51050
    Servicing-approved, Area-AspNetCore
  • [Hot Reload] Do not refresh browser until changes are applied #51210
  • Manual backport of 48874 to release 9.0.3xx #50940
    Servicing-approved, needs team triage, Partner request, Area-dotnet new, 9.0.11
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #51155
    Area-Containers
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51217
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #51208

Updated

    Area-Containers

    Area-Containers, Branch Lockdown

    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
  • Add mixed installation detection and warning to `dotnet --info` #51127
  • Fail the RPM build if FPM tool is not present #51170
  • Fix `dotnet new` to suggest `@` instead of deprecated `::` separator in update notifications #51153
  • Enable CI builds for 2xx branch #50985
  • Add CA2026 analyzer: Prefer JsonElement.Parse over JsonDocument.Parse().RootElement #51209
  • Add analyzer CA1876: Prefer ReadOnlySpan<T> over Span<T> for parameters that are not written to #51216
  • Add CA2027 analyzer to detect redundant Regex.IsMatch guard before Regex.Match #51214
  • Add CA1830 analyzer for StringBuilder.Append(new string(char, int)) #51215
